fact: BEAC reported that Regulation 04/18 on payment services has been in force since 1 January 2019 in the CEMAC, creating payment institutions that let telecom operators and fintechs provide payment services, with COBAC regulations R-2019/01 and R-2019/02 adopted to implement it.
